package handler

import (
	"context"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/nest"
	"testing"
)

// robotRead 在业务 worker 持实体锁读取快照。TCP 回包不能替代本进程的同步屏障。
func robotRead[T any](t *testing.T, engine *nest.NestMgr, target entity.IThreadSafeEntity, read func() T) T {
	t.Helper()
	var value T
	if err := engine.RunLocal(context.Background(), func() {
		target.GetMutex().Lock()
		defer target.GetMutex().Unlock()
		value = read()
	}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return value
}

// robotDecode 只在实体锁内复制编码字符串；解析和 Fatal 留在测试 goroutine。
func robotDecode[T any](t *testing.T, engine *nest.NestMgr, target entity.IThreadSafeEntity, read func() string, decode func(string) (T, error)) T {
	t.Helper()
	raw := robotRead(t, engine, target, read)
	value, err := decode(raw)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return value
}
